approved.en: A US-brokered ceasefire now covers Oleshky and has been extended across the Kherson region, while local ceasefires are also in place in frontline cities. Russian forces attacked the Russian city of Lipetsk with a fire blamed on a Ukrainian strike, and Ukrainian forces recaptured territory, according to Zelenskiy. Putin held calls with leaders of Finland and Norway, discussed Russian history, and faced split opinions among European leaders, while talks about lifting sanctions on a Russian investment fund continued. A suspect in the Nord Stream sabotage was identified as operating under direct command of the Ukrainian army. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Russiske styrker angrep den russiske byen Lipetsk med en brann som ble lagt på en ukrainsk angrep, og ukrainske styrker gjenerobret territorium, ifølge Zelenskiy. Putin holdt samtaler med lederne i Finland og Norge, diskuterte russisk historie, og møtte delte meninger blant europeiske ledere, mens samtaler om å løfte sanksjoner mot et russisk investeringsfond fortsatte. En mistenkt i Nord-Stream-sabotasjen ble identifisert som opererende under direkte kommando fra den ukrainske hæren. Konflikten forårsaket 75 767 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Israeli forces have intensified a crackdown in Hebron, displacing thousands and prompting UN warnings of ethnic cleansing, while IDF raids have expelled farmers and settlers have attacked olive pickers. The Israeli election is deadlocked, with Netanyahu losing a majority, exit polls showing a narrow edge for the opposition and record turnout, while Palestinians in the West Bank fear further violence if Netanyahu remains prime minister. Gaza’s women filmmakers have launched a new academy to turn pain into cinema, and a Hebron groom was caught in a military lockdown. The conflict has produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Det israelske valget sitter fast, med Netanyahu som mister flertall, meningsmålinger som viser en liten fordel for opposisjonen og rekordhøy oppslutning, mens palestinere på Vestbredden frykter mer vold dersom Netanyahu blir statsminister. Kvinnelige filmskapere fra Gaza har startet et nytt akademi for å omforme smerte til film, og en brudgom fra Hebron ble fanget i en militær nedstengning. Konflikten har ifølge UCDP ført til 21 440 dødsfall i kamper i 2024.

approved.en: Hezbollah explosives seized from two Lebanese trucks have led Lebanon's prime minister and security forces to promise a thorough investigation while Israeli artillery and air strikes continue against Hezbollah positions in southern Lebanon, causing civilian casualties. In northern Israel a Hezbollah submunition exploded in a teenager's backpack, killing Elazar Yair Wilensky and wounding dozens, prompting an IDF probe and possible hike restrictions. Qatar has pledged funding for reconstruction in southern Lebanon, announced a massive solar plant project, and its foreign minister called for Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon. The UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Nord-Israel eksploderte en Hezbollah-submunisjon i en tenårings ryggsekk, og drepte Elazar Yair Wilensky og såret dusinvis, noe som har ført til en IDF-undersøkelse og mulige restriksjoner på høyde. Qatar har lovet finansiering til gjenoppbygging i Sør-Libanon, kunngjort et massivt solkraftprosjekt, og utenriksministeren oppfordret til israelsk tilbaketrekning fra Libanon. approved.en: Iran is intensifying threats to the region, urging the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz while Houthi missiles and drones continue striking Saudi oil facilities and airports, prompting the reopening of Riyadh Airport after weeks of disruption. The United States is weighing renewed strikes on Iran, driving oil prices above $117 a barrel, and Iran’s supreme leader and top security chief discussed war and Hormuz. Nuclear inspectors reported no evidence that Iran repaired US-bombed sites, while the IAEA called for nuclear inspections. Israel’s election outcome is being watched for its impact on Iran policy. 123 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

USA vurderer nye angrep mot Iran, noe som driver oljeprisene over 117 dollar per fat, og Irans øverste leder og topp sikkerhetschef diskuterte krig og Hormuz. Kjernefysiske inspektører rapporterte at de ikke fant bevis for at Iran har reparert amerikansk-bombede steder, mens IAEA oppfordret til kjernefysiske inspeksjoner. Israels valgresultat blir fulgt med interesse for hvordan det vil påvirke Irans politikk. 123 kamprelaterte dødsfall har skjedd i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

A French frigate shot down a missile approaching a Belgian mine hunter in the Red Sea, and Russian satellites have been used to guide Houthi fire at Saudi Arabia. Egypt's parliament has approved military support for Saudi Arabia, and Princess Reema has called for a global campaign to defeat the Iran-backed Houthis. Et fransk fregatt skjøt ned et missil som nærmet seg en belgisk minerydder i Rødehavet, og russiske satellitter har blitt brukt til å lede houthi-ild mot Saudi-Arabia. Egypts parlament har godkjent militær støtte til Saudi-Arabia, og prinsesse Reema har oppfordret til en global kampanje for å beseire de Iran-støttede houthiene. Yazidi militia units linked to the PKK are disarming and joining the Iraqi army, and other militia groups have pledged to disarm by mid-2027. Baghdad is engaged in ongoing talks with the Gulf states and Iran on a regional security plan, and the Iraqi prime minister is meeting Jordanian officials to boost trade and energy cooperation. The conflict produced 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Intensified drone attacks by the Rapid Support Forces have hit Nyala, killing at least 21 people, injuring 40 and knocking out power in southeast Sudan, worsening civilian hardship. The Sudanese Armed Forces and allied militias continue to grind the conflict, while women under siege are increasingly acting as frontline responders to meet basic needs. Hundreds of thousands of Sudanese refugees are now hosted in Chad as the regional humanitarian emergency expands. The United Nations warns of a looming famine risk as the war grinds on, and the conflict caused 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

President Kiir reshuffled the South Sudan Revenue Authority board, reinstating two commissioners after a cancelled order, and the Bar Association launched a roadmap to improve access to justice. The government partnered with Israel's Gilat to provide nationwide satellite internet and secured a UNESCO world-heritage nomination for the Boma-Bandingilo inscription. Governor Dollar promoted the reintegration of IDPs and returnees, and the U.S. Embassy remembered staff who died supporting South Sudanese people. 2 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Somali army convoys continue to be ambushed by al-Shabaab near Baidoa, while al-Shabaab suffered heavy losses in operations that reportedly killed 75 of its fighters. The Somali army also reported a major battle near Buurhakaba district with dozens of its soldiers killed. Fitgharan forces now control the Mogadishu-Baidoa corridor and Laftagareen forces have seized Buurhakaba and a town in Bay, extending combat in the south. Ethiopia has withdrawn over 3,000 troops and will not intervene in the South West State conflict. The conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Fitgharan-styrkene kontrollerer nå korridoren Mogadishu-Baidoa og Laftagareen-styrkene har erobret Buurhakaba og en by i Bay, og utvider kampene i sør.
